spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (ददते)
1 To give.
2 To relinquish.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
Who gives or bestows.
E.
दद to give, and श aff.

m. (-दः)
1 A gift, a donation.
2 Giving.
E.
दद to give, घञ् aff.

mfn. (-दन्-दती-दत्)
Giving.
E.
दा to give, शतृ aff.

n. (-नं)
Gift, giving, donation.
E.
दद to give, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-दिः-दिः-दि)
Who or what gives or bestows.
E.
दा to give, कि aff.

mfn. (-वान्-दुषी-वः)
Giving, who or what gives.
E.
दा to give, वसु aff.

mfn. (-दृत्)
Fearful, alarmed.
E.
दॄ to fear, क्विप् affix, and the radical vowel made short.

mfn. (-वान्-शुषी-वः)
Seeing, looking.
E.
दृश to see, वसु affix, इट् inserted.

mfn. (-श्रान्-शुषी-श्वः)
Seeing, looking.
E.
दृश to see वसु aff.

m. (-द्रुः)
Cutaneous and herpetick eruptions; also दद्रूः: or with कन् added दद्रुक, m. (-कः)

m. (-घ्नः)
A kind of cassia, (C. tora.)
E.
दद्रु herpes, and घ्न, destroying, remedying; also दद्रूघ्न.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Herpetick, afflicted with herpes.
E.
दद्रु, and न affix; also दद्रूण.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Herpetick, diseased by herpes.
E.
दद्रु herpes, रोग a disease, and इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
A donor, one who gives.
E.
दाद, and द who gives.

mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि)
Giving.
E.
दद to give, णिनि aff.
